title: PEAD-NLP: FinBERT earnings call signal layer for H159b
applied_action: Added H163 QUEUED entry to hypothesis-log.md
summary: Augment the beta-neutral PEAD gap signal with a FinBERT sentiment score from earnings call transcripts. ACL 2025 paper reports FinBERT achieves 57.6–58.3% directional accuracy on post-announcement returns — additive to price-based gap signal. Combined EAR+SUE+NLP signal generated 12.5% annualized abnormal returns vs 4.4% for price gap alone in recent studies.

source.paper: Enhancing Post Earnings Announcement Drift Measurement with Large Language Models
source.key_finding: FinBERT: 57.6% (positive group), 58.3% (negative group) classification accuracy for PEAD direction

implementation.data_needed: Earnings call transcripts — SEC EDGAR 8-K Item 2.02 filings (free) or Motley Fool/Seeking Alpha for structured transcripts
pipeline: 2. Segment by speaker (management vs analyst Q&A)
4. Aggregate: finbert_score = mean(positive) - mean(negative) across management remarks
5. Filter: only enter PEAD position if finbert_score > +0.1 (aligned with price gap)
implementation.test_universe: H159 events (374 OOS events) — apply filter, check if win rate improves above 63.9%

expected_improvement: Reduce false positives in PEAD signals. Base win rate 63.9%; NLP filter should push 68–72% on retained signals. Cost: ~20% fewer trades (filtered out).
risks: Transcript timing — 8-K sometimes filed days after earnings call, not same day
FinBERT fine-tuned on analyst reports not call transcripts — domain mismatch
Computational cost: 374 transcripts × ~30 min inference = 3h GPU time for backtest
